source.title: Northern Whig, 16 April 1924, p. 4 ("Unionists returned to power in Tyrone: Clogher Rural District")
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and divisions read on the OCR of the Northern Whig's nomination list of 16 April 1924 and checked against the Ulster Herald of 19 April 1924

note: Nomination-day report for the sixteen seats in Clogher rural district, one member per division. Twelve Unionist candidates were nominated and returned unopposed; no nominations were received for Aghafad, Errigal, Foremass and Newtownsaville, which were filled by co-option. There was no contest and no poll. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
